member.name: T:TargetableMassAttacks.TargetableMassAttacksControls
member.summary: A class for controlling mass-targeting settings.

member.name: M:TargetableMassAttacks.TargetableMassAttacksControls.EnableMassTargetingFor(System.Predicate{BattlePlayingCardDataInUnitModel})
member.summary: Specifically enables subtargeting for cards satifying the specified condition. By default, subtargeting is enabled for cards of range FarArea or FarAreaEach if their affection is One, Team or All, and for cards of other ranges (excluding Instance) if their affection is TeamNear. Specific enabling has precedence over disabling!
member.param: The condition on which to additionally enable subtargeting.

member.name: M:TargetableMassAttacks.TargetableMassAttacksControls.DisableMassTargetingFor(System.Predicate{BattlePlayingCardDataInUnitModel})
member.summary: Disables subtargeting for cards satifying the specified condition. By default, subtargeting is enabled for cards of range FarArea or FarAreaEach if their affection is One, Team or All, and for cards of other ranges (excluding Instance) if their affection is TeamNear. Specific enabling has precedence over disabling!
member.param: The condition on which to disable subtargeting.

member.name: M:TargetableMassAttacks.TargetableMassAttacksControls.IsRespectBlockDice
member.summary: Checks if mass attacks have been set to not target blocked speed dice (as per CheckBlockDice, including any patches to it).
member.returns: if mass attacks have been set to ignore blocked speed dice; otherwise .

member.name: M:TargetableMassAttacks.TargetableMassAttacksControls.SetRespectBlockDice
member.summary: Sets mass attacks to not target blocked speed dice (as per CheckBlockDice, including any patches to it).
